name: specstride-dsh
description: The dsh host of Specstride: the host package of specs/120-host-dsh and the kanban tab of specs/121-dsh-kanban. This root manifest is private tooling; the npm name of the host package is chosen by the package pipeline (an assumption of spec 120), and everything of the engine this repository needs arrives through the pinned core tarballs in vendor/core/.
